4507.note_text: Examples: Portable weighbridge, group of associated non-automatic axle (or wheel) load weighers (1) This Recommendation covers only weighbridges and groups of associated non- automatic axle (or wheel) load weighers that determine simultaneously the total mass of a road vehicle with all axles (or wheels) being simultaneously supported by appropriate parts of a load receptor.
